name: repo-pane
description: Repo Pane for Git: a pane inside Claude Code for every repo and worktree — changes, commit, branches, drawn history graph, git-flow, stash, tags, pull requests, publish and clone, with OAuth, token or SSH sign-in for Bitbucket, GitHub and GitLab

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: Comma-separated absolute paths of repos to watch for everyone using this setup; repos can also be added from the pane

cloneDir.title: Clone folder
cloneDir.description: Folder new clones go into, one subfolder per repo; empty = your home folder

useSsh.title: Fall back to SSH
useSsh.description: When an https fetch, pull, push or clone has no credentials, retry it over SSH without changing the repo's remotes

fetchMinutes.title: Fetch interval (minutes)
fetchMinutes.description: How often to run git fetch on every repo; 0 turns periodic fetch off

refreshSeconds.title: Local refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read local status (no network)

bitbucketOAuthKey.title: Bitbucket OAuth consumer key
bitbucketOAuthKey.description: A team's Bitbucket OAuth consumer (callback http://127.0.0.1:53682/callback): everyone then signs in with one click

githubOAuthClientId.title: GitHub OAuth app client ID
githubOAuthClientId.description: A GitHub OAuth app with Device Flow enabled: everyone then signs in with one click and a code

githubHost.title: GitHub host
githubHost.description: github.com, or a GitHub Enterprise host

gitlabOAuthClientId.title: GitLab application ID
gitlabOAuthClientId.description: A non-confidential GitLab application (redirect http://127.0.0.1:53682/callback, scopes api read_repository write_repository)

gitlabHost.title: GitLab host
gitlabHost.description: gitlab.com, or a self-hosted GitLab host
